groups.title: Text
groups.summary: Markup, rules and pixel lettering. Text is measured in terminal cells, so emoji and CJK keep the grid.

groups.title: Layout
groups.summary: Containers that place other widgets. Any widget can sit inside any container, including a live dashboard.

groups.title: Status and progress
groups.summary: The widgets a live session updates: facts, steps, trees, bars, phases, spinners and the log region.

groups.title: Charts
groups.summary: Bars, stacked bars, sparklines, histograms and braille line and scatter charts, all scaled to their cells.

examples.title: Text and markup
examples.summary: Spectre-style markup: theme roles, colours and decorations, reduced for each tier.

examples.title: Key/value list
examples.summary: Aligned facts with optional status marks, as a summary beside a run.
examples.csharp:
KeyValueList facts = new KeyValueList()
    .Add("Module", "[bold]ConsoleMonster[/]")
    .Add("Version", "0.0.4 [muted]→[/] [bold]2.0.0[/]")
    .Add("Frameworks", "netstandard2.0, net472, net8.0")
    .Add("Signing", "skipped", StatusKind.Skip)
    .Add("Tests", "1 skipped on PowerShell 7", StatusKind.Warn);
Terminal.Write(facts);

examples.title: Status list
examples.summary: Steps with a status symbol and a detail on the right.
examples.csharp:
StatusList steps = new StatusList()
    .Add("Restore NuGet packages", StatusKind.Pass, "1.6 s")
    .Add("Compile ConsoleMonster", StatusKind.Pass, "4.7 s")
    .Add("Run Pester on PowerShell 7", StatusKind.Warn, "1 skipped")
    .Add("Sign module files", StatusKind.Skip, "skipped")
    .Add("Pack ConsoleMonster.2.0.0.nupkg", StatusKind.Running)
    .Add("Publish to PowerShell Gallery", StatusKind.Pending);
Terminal.Write(steps);
examples.powershell:
New-ConsoleStatusList {
    New-ConsoleStatusItem 'Restore NuGet packages' -Status Pass -Detail '1.6 s'
    New-ConsoleStatusItem 'Compile ConsoleMonster' -Status Pass -Detail '4.7 s'
    New-ConsoleStatusItem 'Run Pester on PowerShell 7' -Status Warn -Detail '1 skipped'
    New-ConsoleStatusItem 'Sign module files' -Status Skip -Detail 'skipped'
    New-ConsoleStatusItem 'Pack ConsoleMonster.2.0.0.nupkg' -Status Running
    New-ConsoleStatusItem 'Publish to PowerShell Gallery' -Status Pending
} | Write-ConsoleWidget

examples.title: Log region
examples.summary: Timed log lines with levels; in a live session it collects Console and PowerShell output.
examples.powershell:
New-ConsoleLog -Height 5 {
    New-ConsoleLogEntry 'Discovered 4 domain controllers in 2 domains' -Level Info -At 2s
    New-ConsoleLogEntry 'DC02: replication partner DC05 last success 3h ago' -Level Warning -At 31s
    New-ConsoleLogEntry 'DC02: USN rollback check failed (event 2095)' -Level Error -At 44s
    New-ConsoleLogEntry 'Collected 186 rule inputs from DC01' -Level Info -At 52s
    New-ConsoleLogEntry 'Using cached schema snapshot' -Level Verbose -At 53s
} | Write-ConsoleWidget
